what: One real native plan, invocation and readback of the haiku-mechanical-v1 route. A code-only review by the storyboard critic, read only, of scripts/public_state_test.py and the two modules it exercises. This is a different task from the completed caption gate trial and it is not that trial repeated.
rehearsal_note: The route's effective_from date correctly excludes the shipped 2026-10-11 edition, so the plan was made in a scratch worktree whose copy of config/claude_runtime.json had only effective_from lowered to 2026-10-11. The production config, the shipped edition, the controller and every reservation are untouched. No controller resource was reserved because no edition was open. A production use reserves the role's own storyboard_critics resource exactly as the Opus assignment does.

plan.packet: a real standard storyboard-critic packet generated by daily_production.py from the shipped 2026-10-11 board and claims, with the complete current guides and both treatment boards bound, plus a mechanical declaration

fail_closed_readback: The same planner refused a second packet that named video-engine/src/lib/DispatchOverlays.tsx: Mechanical route never touches video-engine/src/lib/DispatchOverlays.tsx.

invocation.observed_effort: unknown, the host does not report it for a subagent

usage.note: host aggregate across calls, not one prompt, and not billed tokens. Per call context and cache components are in the private usage audit.

worker_limits_it_reported: It had only the Read tool, so it could not verify the packet hash or the input hashes and said so. The director recomputed the packet hash, which matched the plan.
It read most but not all bound guides and listed the six it did not read.
It did not run the tests.

grading.method: Every finding was checked against the code by the director before anything was changed.

findings.what: the recursion test imported both modules itself, so its assertion was true by construction. It now imports each alone and asserts the other is absent.
the mutation test never ran the CLI. It now patches the CLI back to the raw export and requires the leak assertions to fail.
the overwrite refusal test accepted any non zero exit. It now requires the refusal message.
the export never ran the credential scan a checkpoint runs. It now refuses credential-shaped text and writes nothing.

findings.verdict: confirmed, a contradiction between the docstring and an assertion
findings.what: the shipment manifest path survives only as a checkout relative token, which is the sanitizer's established behavior and what is archived. The docstring now says so. The owner may decide it should be digested instead.
a draft id or routing file name in free text under a neutral key was not redacted. The export now refuses any value that sat under a private key and survives elsewhere.
private digests were never asserted absent. They are now covered by the same sweep and by the leak assertions.
only one root was checked and the default root was never exercised. The export refuses absolute local paths from any root and the default root has its own test.

the owner grant redaction is existing code. The real 2026-10-11 ledger exercised it and the merged archive is byte identical under the hardened export. A valid grant fixture needs repair_guard's chain and is left for a separate change.
a hard link defeated the overwrite refusal. The CLI now also compares file identity.
increments were promised and never tested. The fixture now carries escalations and an escalation ceiling and asserts them unchanged.
a charge key containing a private word would have been digested. The export now refuses if the sanitizer altered a charge block.
a note containing an address is digested, which is the sanitizer's purpose.
portable and expand are not inverses for a literal token. It affects checkpoint restore and not the public export.
restore then export provenance in claude_checkpoint is outside this change and was reported by code reading only.

grading.overall: Seventeen findings, none false, none an overreach in what it claimed from the code. About half were real defects in the new test file or a real gap in the new export, and all of those are fixed. The review is useful evidence for read only code review of a gate test. It is one task, and it is not evidence for any wider route.
